About us

A home bakery loved for fresh flavour

Nandini's Bake Studio is a home bakery in Greater Noida, loved for its fresh birthday cakes, cupcakes and desserts — baked to order for birthdays, celebrations and everyday cravings.

From custom cakes for birthdays, weddings and anniversaries to fresh breads, cupcakes, cookies and savoury options, everything is made fresh for your occasion.
